description: Build an evidence-based map of E-Collab architecture, entry points, dependencies, contracts, tests, and ownership boundaries before complex changes.

# Codebase Knowledge

Inspect README/docs, relevant directories, composer configuration, CI, tests, API reference, database schema/migrations, WebSocket code, and AI endpoints as applicable.

Trace callers and callees. Record the affected data flow and authoritative source for each contract. Verify names and paths rather than assuming them. Reuse existing patterns and services. Avoid speculative refactors.
